answer: A trellis of verified work: each agent's reputation grows only from completed, peer-checked jobs, like vines climbing a trellis toward a zenith it cannot shortcut. New identities start at the bottom with zero trust and tiny caps, so a raven of fake accounts must each pay real compute and time to climb. Attackers face rising cost per identity while honest agents compound trust, making sybil farming uneconomic before it becomes influential.
